name: SetUpTlb
evidence: runs the TLB set-up func_001FA9C0 (ExitProgram calls it)

name: TerminateProgram
evidence: runs SetUpTlb, then ExitProgramSyscall with the status (the program's entry, SignalProcess and the TLB set-up call it)

name: GetProcessId
evidence: returns 1, the only process (GetProcessIdFor calls it)

name: SignalProcess
evidence: exits the program with the signal as status when the process is 1, else does nothing and returns 0 (SendSignalFor calls it)

name: PrintToDebugConsole
evidence: hands a line to CallDebugService with request 0x10 (BufferOutputChar calls it)

name: StoreChannelWord
evidence: the command channel's handler of command 1: stores the packet's value in the channel's table of words at its index

name: StoreIopChannelAddress
evidence: the command channel's handler of command 0: stores the IOP's address of its channel

name: GetChannelWord
evidence: returns the command channel's word at an index (InitRemoteCalls reads one)

name: InitCommandChannel
evidence: once (D_002779B8), sets up the command channel's control record, handler table and words, installs its DMA handler func_001FA6B0 and exchanges its addresses with the IOP

name: ShutDownCommandChannel
evidence: disables and removes the command channel's DMA handler and clears its flag

name: SetCommandHandler
evidence: stores a handler and its argument for a command in the channel's system or user table (its top bit chooses)

name: ClearCommandHandler
evidence: clears a command's handler in the channel's system or user table

name: SendCommandPacket
evidence: sends a command packet, and optionally a block of data, to the IOP by DMA with StartIopDma, or StartIopDmaFromInterrupt when asked from an interrupt handler

name: SendCommand
evidence: sends a command packet with SendCommandPacket outside interrupts (BindRemoteService and CallRemoteService send through it)

name: SendCommandFromInterrupt
evidence: sends a command packet with SendCommandPacket from an interrupt handler (AnswerIopCall and AnswerServiceLookup send through it)

name: HandleCommandInterrupt
evidence: the command channel's DMA handler, which runs the handler of each received command and re-arms the receive chain

name: WriteBackDataCacheRange
evidence: original assembly: writes back and invalidates the data cache lines of a range, 64 bytes at a time (the IOP clients call it before a transfer)
